subject.title: fix(agents): repair orphaned tool_use pairs on compaction prune path

question: Should compaction drop aborted assistant tool-call turns before summarization, matching strict-provider prompt replay, or preserve them with synthetic tool results?
rationale: The patch fixes a real session-state failure, but the drop-versus-synthesize choice controls how interrupted assistant turns are represented in future compaction summaries.

options.title: Accept drop-policy compaction repair
options.body: Approve this PR if compaction should discard aborted assistant tool-call turns to keep strict-provider transcripts valid.

options.title: Require synthetic-result preservation
options.body: Ask for a targeted rewrite if interrupted turns must remain visible to the summarizer with explicit synthetic tool results.

options.title: Pause for broader recovery design
options.body: Leave the PR unmerged if maintainers want a larger policy design for aborted-turn recovery before changing compaction behavior.

recommendation.title: Accept drop-policy compaction repair
recommendation.body: Approve this PR if compaction should discard aborted assistant tool-call turns to keep strict-provider transcripts valid.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest history connection to both staged compaction and the shared transcript repair contract used by this PR.
